lines.text: In a song of Asaph, the psalmist lifts his eyes to the hills and asks where help comes from.
The psalmist's help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
He will not let your foot slip, and the Protector of Judah will neither slumber nor sleep.
The LORD is your keeper and the shade on your right hand, so the sun will not strike you by day.
The LORD will guard you from all evil and watch over your coming and going, now and forevermore.
